newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street up at opening of trade.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street up at opening of trade.

text.p: Wall Street stocks opened up Monday on momentum from the markets' recent strong performance.
Analysts said investors would be keeping an eye on Tuesday's release of U.S. retail sales data. The figures are the first of a raft of economic numbers out this week.
The Dow industrials were up 29 points at 7198 and the S&P 500 rose 3.91 points to 828.76. The long bond was unchanged to yield 6.89 percent.
The Nasdaq composite index also was up six points to 1341.
